Value: delta_subscribe
Topic with which to place a subscription.

Acknowledgment type for the delta_subscribe command.
Value is a comma separated list of one or more of the
following: none, received, processed, completed or stats.

If specified with an AMPS command requesting an
acknowledgment message, all requested acknowledgment
messages will contain the CommandId in the acknowledgment
response header.

A Boolean (true or false) used to determine the type of data
sent to the subscriber.
A value of true will, for example, not include a SOAP
envelope.

String which is used as a content filter expression.
When using XML, the filter must be wrapped in a CDATA.
